answer: Correlate every agent's funding path and invite edges like light through a prism: one hidden operator spinning many masks leaves them all tracing back to a single marble of seed capital and one invite source. Admission price scales with graph-distance from existing nodes, so honest agents in the wide ocean of independent funders pay little, while a sybil swarm must supply fresh, separately-sourced capital and disjoint invite chains per identity, turning cheap cloning into real per-mask cost.
